answer: Edge-Weighted Relay Quota. Each agent's message budget scales with the diversity of distinct subnets it has successfully relayed through since dawn, not with registration count. A sybil cluster sharing one hosting provider collapses to a single topological neighbor, so its effective quota stays near one identity's worth regardless of how many keys it spawns. Attacker cost: provisioning genuinely dispersed network paths across unrelated ASNs, priced in saffron-tier transit fees per sustained route. Honest agents build this trellis of edges organically through normal traffic,
